name: The Green Pearl Heritage Resort & Lawn
address: Opp. Karnavati Club, S.G. Highway, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380058

reviews.author: Jigar Patel
reviews.text: Magnificent sprawling lush lawn with vintage heritage archways! Accommodated 350 people with extreme comfort. Ample parking.

reviews.author: Sneha Shah
reviews.text: Management was super helpful with sound permissions and clean green rooms for bridal prep.

reviews.author: Amit Trivedi
reviews.text: Great ambiance, though approach road had minor traffic during peak evening hours.

name: Shivalik Grand Royal Banquet
address: 4th Floor, Shivalik Square, Prahlad Nagar Rd, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380015

reviews.author: Kavita Dave
reviews.text: Fully air-conditioned acoustic crystal halls, very aesthetic golden chandeliers and polite staff.

reviews.author: Rohit Joshi
reviews.text: Priced well for central Ahmedabad. Elevator queue can get slightly busy during simultaneous hall exits.

name: Rasraj Gourmet Royal Caterers
address: Near VS Hospital, Ellis Bridge, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380006

reviews.author: Parth Mehta
reviews.text: Their Gujarati-Marwari fusion menu blew everyone away! The Mohanthal with Rabdi and Mexican live tacos were hits.

reviews.author: Bhavna Ben
reviews.text: Special 100% pure Jain kitchen team. Superb hygiene, crystal clear glassware and spotless staff uniforms.

reviews.author: Dhaval Shah
reviews.text: A bit on the higher quote side, but absolute zero food waste management and timely refills.

name: Annapurna Swad Caterers & Live Counters
address: 12 Shanti Nagar, Near Ankur Cross Road, Naranpura, Ahmedabad 380013

reviews.author: Meera Patel
reviews.text: Great traditional Kathiyawadi & North Indian counters. Everyone loved the live undhiyu and jalebi fafda counter.

reviews.author: Jayesh Bhai
reviews.text: Pocket friendly and solid taste. Recommended booking 2 months in advance.

name: Utsav Mandap & Floral Artistry
address: Shop 4, Sunrise Mall Lane, Vastrapur, Ahmedabad 380015

reviews.author: Pooja Vora
reviews.text: Fresh marigold and mogra floral hangings were stunning! The pastel mandap gave royal aesthetic vibes.

reviews.author: Hiren Shah
reviews.text: Delivered exactly the 3D render preview shown during initial meetings.

name: Drishti Weddings & Cinema
address: Gulbai Tekra, Near University Ground, Navrangpura, Ahmedabad 380009

reviews.author: Karan Raval
reviews.text: Their candid shots captured the emotional tears during bidaai and laughter in sangeet perfectly. Fast teaser delivery!

reviews.author: Priyanka Soni
reviews.text: Cinematic drone shots and same-week highlight reel was a massive hit on family WhatsApp groups.

reviews.author: Chirag Modi
reviews.text: The energy of the Nashik dhol troupe during the baraat was insane! Kept everyone dancing for 2 hours non-stop.

reviews.author: Aakash Desai
reviews.text: Great transition between traditional sanedo/garba and Bollywood EDM.

reviews.author: Radhika Patel
reviews.text: Subtle dewy makeup that lasted 14 hours through rituals and warm lighting without caking or smudging.

reviews.author: Ekta Parekh
reviews.text: Punctual, friendly, and draped my heavy Gujarati panetar saree to perfection.
